title: Gwop (Player)
text: Gwop Gwop (short for Gangsta Wapol) was a notorious undercover narcotics officer famous for infiltrating and dismantling the Lis crime family. Starting his career in the East Gwop transferred west to infiltrate Lis's family earning the trust of both Lis and Bryan. Famous for running contraband in the great cheese wars to sell for Solana, Gwop was able to further endear himself to the crime lord Lis. After getting banned once he returned under the psyuedonym Gwod. Members of his crew identified themselves with their moto and decal "onGwod." In a final act of defiance and justice Gwop sent copious amounts of evidence documenting all of Lis and Bryan's transgressions earning the admiration of Aguru who pardoned him and allowed him to return to the server on a 3rd account. He has since retired and can be spotted tending to his fields of rice in Ahnimar, onGwod. Known aliases Gwop, Gwob, Gwoq, Gwod, Gwop, Gwopamolley, Bape.

Gwop

Gwop (short for Gangsta Wapol) was a notorious undercover narcotics officer famous for infiltrating and dismantling the Lis crime family. Starting his career in the East Gwop transferred west to infiltrate Lis's family earning the trust of both Lis and Bryan. Famous for running contraband in the great cheese wars to sell for Solana, Gwop was able to further endear himself to the crime lord Lis. After getting banned once he returned under the psyuedonym Gwod. Members of his crew identified themselves with their moto and decal "onGwod." In a final act of defiance and justice Gwop sent copious amounts of evidence documenting all of Lis and Bryan's transgressions earning the admiration of Aguru who pardoned him and allowed him to return to the server on a 3rd account. He has since retired and can be spotted tending to his fields of rice in Ahnimar, onGwod.


Known aliases

Gwop, Gwob, Gwoq, Gwod, Gwop, Gwopamolley, Bape.
